model_output.verdict: The Cobalt Pay role is an engineering management job, while your background is in field operations and home services. I'd pass on this application because your resume doesn't show engineering management or backend engineering. For operations roles, I'd still want to know how large your teams and budgets were.
write_up: Cobalt Pay is looking for a different track from the one your resume shows. Your progression at Northstar Home Services tells a coherent operations story, but it's common for senior resumes to list responsibilities without showing how large the operation was or what changed. That makes this one less competitive in a pile of senior operations resumes.

Your line about partnering with Finance on the annual operating plan is the best model: it names a partner and a concrete piece of work. Your experience also sits above Education, and the Northstar progression is easy to follow. What remains unclear is the size of the operation you lead.

Let's start with your current role. Add the team and budget figures you can substantiate to the field operations line, then name the initiatives and changes behind the strategy and fleet work. For Cobalt Pay, the operations background alone doesn't establish the engineering experience the posting requires.

cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter may not know the business or how large it is. A short description would give your regional responsibilities a setting.

cards.line: - Responsible for field operations, dispatch and customer care across the Upper Midwest
cards.cannot_tell: The territory is named, but the size of the operation isn't. At senior director level, a recruiter needs a team, budget or other figure to understand what you led.

cards.question: How many people or locations did the operation cover, and what budget were you responsible for?

cards.line: - Led operational strategy and continuous improvement initiatives

cards.line: - Managed managers across multiple regions
cards.cannot_tell: Managing managers is important at this level, but the number of managers and their responsibilities are missing.

cards.line: - Rolled out a new scheduling system
cards.cannot_tell: The rollout is concrete, but a recruiter can't tell what your part involved or what changed for dispatch or technicians.

cards.question: What did you do during the rollout, and what changed after it?

cards.line: - Improved first-time fix rate

cards.question: What were your main daily responsibilities in the service department?
